tools.name: find_data

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Every endpoint this server fronts, with its exact per-call USD price (x402, USDC on Base) and a one-line summary, read live from the route table. Free.

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: The suggestion box: ask for data we don't have (a pre-2015 filing, an uncovered ticker, an unsupported chain, a whole dataset). Requests feed the nightly ingestion queue — filings are usually available within ~24h. Include contact if you want to hear back. Free.

Paid: call without x_payment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_data, read_url, pdf_extract, news, news_batch · Private data: find_data, request_data, pdf_extract, news_poll · Public sink: find_data, news_batch · Destructive: pdf_extract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_data, read_url, pdf_extract, news, news_batch · Private data: find_data, request_data, pdf_extract, news_poll · Public sink: find_data, news_batch · Destructive: pdf_extract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
